name: ADULTEROUS_WOMAN
canonical: the woman taken in adultery, a young ancient Judean woman of about twenty with smooth olive skin and long loose dishevelled black hair falling across her face, a tear-streaked cheek and head bowed low in shame, her plain dust-brown robe disordered and slipping from one bare shoulder, kneeling alone and trembling on the dusty temple stone
